citations.narrative:
An outdoor shelter in the blackbuck enclosure is not being maintained in good repair. Contained in the enclosure were
shelters constructed of steel panels. One of them had a damaged panel located on the right side of the shelter. The panel
was torn allowing a piece of sheet metal to extend into the shelter creating a hole with jagged edges and sharp points.
Failure to maintain enclosures can allow for holes, unstable structures, and sharp points which can result in injury or
entrapment of the animals. Facilities shall be structurally sound and maintained in good repair to protect the animals from
injury and contain them.
Correct by 6/19/26
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
